description: Open API and MCP server to read and search the Urantia Papers, with cross-references to the Bible and 21 other texts. No key.
rules: No API key or account is needed. The base URL is https://api.urantia.dev and the MCP server is https://api.urantia.dev/mcp.
Paragraph references use paper:section.paragraph, for example 2:5.1.
Quote the text that the API returns, with its reference. Do not quote the Urantia Papers from memory.
